intro: Stories about our coffee, easy brewing tips and what is happening at the cafe.
ctaText: Read about it, then come and try it. Reserve a table and we will have a cup ready for you.

posts.title: How We Choose Our Coffee Beans
posts.excerpt: A short look at where our beans come from and how we pick them.
posts.imageAlt: Three cups of coffee on a wooden table
content: Every bag of beans we buy is tasted before it reaches our shelves. We look for a balanced flavor, a clean finish and a fair price for the farmer.
Most of our beans come from small farms. We roast in small batches every week, so what you drink is always fresh.

posts.title: Three Easy Ways to Brew at Home
posts.excerpt: You do not need a fancy machine to make a good cup at home.
posts.imageAlt: Busy coffee shop with barista making coffee
content: A French press, a pour over and a simple moka pot can all make great coffee. The most important thing is fresh beans and clean water.
Start with one spoon of coffee for every cup of water, then adjust until it tastes right for you.

posts.title: Weekend Music and Coffee Nights
posts.excerpt: Join us on Saturday evenings for live music and fresh desserts.
posts.imageAlt: pour over coffee being made in a cafe
content: Every Saturday evening, local musicians play in our cafe. It is a relaxed night with good coffee and good company.
Seats fill up quickly, so we suggest reserving a table in advance.
